description: Source code for a Wear OS watch face service that loads and displays calendar data, including permission handling, background data loading, and rendering.

classes.name: CalendarWatchFaceService
classes.description: Main service class for the watch face, extending CanvasWatchFaceService.

classes.name: CalendarWatchFaceService.Engine
classes.description: Inner class extending CanvasWatchFaceService.Engine, handling rendering, permissions, data loading, and user interaction.

classes.name: LoadMeetingsTask
classes.description: AsyncTask subclass to load calendar meetings asynchronously.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the engine, sets style, checks permissions, and starts loading meetings if permitted.

methods.name: onCreateEngine
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Engine instance.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws the calendar info or permission message onto the canvas.

methods.name: onVisibilityChanged
methods.description: Handles registration/unregistration of broadcast receiver and triggers data load when visible.

methods.name: onTapCommand
methods.description: Handles tap events, prompting permission activity if needed.

methods.name: onMeetingsLoaded
methods.description: Updates the number of meetings and redraws.

methods.name: cancelLoadMeetingTask
methods.description: Cancels ongoing meeting load task if any.
